title: ArrowVectorField
author: DeepBuild
description: ArrowVectorField(func, x_range, y_range) as one vector_field@1 of arrows on a grid, from one formula. a unit is the frame's short side ÷ 8 in u (fw, fh), so the frame is 14.22 × 8 units at 16:9; y flips and the origin moves to the frame's center; radians become degrees; a stroke width w becomes w × unit ÷ 100 u; font_size f is an em of f ÷ 96 units.

x.about: the field's x component, a function of x and y

y.about: the field's y component, a function of x and y

x_range.about: x_range: [min, max, delta] the field covers, in units

y_range.about: y_range: [min, max, delta] the field covers, in units

color.about: the arrows' color; unwritten, the accent role

refuses.length_func: Leave it out: arrow lengths follow the field's own sigmoid scaling.
refuses.colors: Write color: one color; a magnitude ramp is the field's `arrows.color`.
refuses.three_dimensions: Write z as well, on math.axes3d, for a field in space.
refuses.use_vectorized: Leave it out: every math@1 shape is a path the renderer strokes and fills on its own.
refuses.sheen_factor: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.sheen_direction: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.background_stroke_width: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.background_stroke_color: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.joint_type: Leave it out: paths join by the look's line style.
refuses.cap_style: Leave it out: paths cap by the look's line style.
refuses.shade_in_3d: Leave it out: 2D shapes draw flat; for a lit shape use math.surface.
